attempted_claim: Let k be algebraically closed and A=kQ/<I> a graded skew-gentle algebra with graded orbifold surface model (S,O,eta,Delta) as in Chang-Jin-Schroll-Wang Theorem 5.1, under the same properness/smoothness hypotheses. Assume S has genus 0 with |O|<=1 and omega_eta(gamma)!=0 for every simple closed curve gamma (equivalently sum_{j in J} m_j != 2 for all J with m_i=omega_eta(partial_i)+2). Is per(A) silting-discrete, i.e. are there only finitely many silting objects between any two comparable silting objects? In particular are conditions (1), (2), (3) of Theorem 5.1 all equivalent?
decisive_failure: The necessary direction (1)=>(2)<=>(3) of CJSW Theorem 5.1 is confirmed from the paper, but the sufficiency direction (2)=>(1) could not be established: all three concrete routes fail at the documented endomorphism-closure gap, and no independently valuable emergent increment or completable target-adjacent alternative was found within the bounded pass.
